propositions: Auto-deploy container restart interrupts in-flight code reviews that exceed the 45-second drain timeout, causing teardown-corrupted reviews to cast a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic backfill reconciliation recovery.

Drain timeout constant (45s) is undersized relative to measured review duration (260-911s observed; default 1200s timeout); raising DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and stop_grace_period to 1320s allows graceful quiescence of in-flight reviews without interruption.

Retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) caused by transient conditions like git-fetch hangs must defer voting (post no vote) and record retry attempts, leaving changes vote-less so the backfill reconciler re-drives them automatically within RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.

Bounded escalation on retryable gaps: after N consecutive vote-less attempts on the same (change_id, revision), cast the fail-closed -1 vote with a retries-exhausted note and emit VOTER_ERROR metric (default cap is 3 attempts; RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS is env-overridable).

Terminal outcomes (indeterminate, finding, merge-path failures) must continue to cast fail-closed -1 votes; only retryable infrastructure/transient failures (not concluded review verdicts) are eligible for vote-less deferral and reconciler re-drive.

The review_attempts ledger (keyed by change_id and revision) must be distinct from the voted table, shaped to support bb9b contributor re-trigger via reset_attempts(change_id, revision) DELETE semantics, and initialized via record_attempt / queried via attempt_count.
